note: Sites 001-023 are tent-only. The trailer sites on the river side of the bank road back onto the Delaware River behind a line of bank trees. Boat ramp; no pets or alcohol. --Claude
summary: NJ Outdoors read (dep.nj.gov UNREAD). Confirmed $20/$25, 78 sites, showers; added flush toilets, max_rig_ft 47 (45 trailer sites take 23 ft+), season opens 04-01 / closes 12-15 from the calendar. WATERFRONT: recommend riverfront -> riverview (continuous bank tree line between the bank-side sites and the river; NJ Outdoors flags no site as waterfront). Note cleaned.
flags: WATERFRONT riverfront -> riverview (recommended downgrade). NJ Outdoors' per-site data flags NO site WaterfrontSite (its other parks do flag them, e.g. Atsion and Stokes). ParkMap_20 draws the bank road with sites on its river side (about 031-040 and 044-058). Imagery z19 at 41.0136,-75.0858: the river is ~150 m wide (riverfront class, not creekside), and the bank-side camping strip is open grass from the road to a continuous line of tall bank trees, about 15-20 m deep, with RVs parked ~25-40 m from the water. The curation doc counts a continuous treeline as a buffer ('a view = ... behind a thin line of trees'), so no site could be placed with open ground to the water. Stored evidence ('campers/RVs along bank-side road within ~1 pad of waterline') does not mention the tree band.
Phone: none stored; NJ Outdoors 'Direct Line' (908) 841-9575.
Pin 41.01296,-75.08484 is in the middle of the north (trailer) loop on imagery; tent sites 001-023 lie ~600 m SW. Within ~250 m of the trailer-site centroid; no move.
Dump: NJ Outdoors lists no sanitary station at Worthington (amenities Bathhouse, Boat Launch Ramp, River/Stream); dump left unset.
